notes.notes:
The free DLC game was released on time.
Game capacity is 255 MB.
In the Steam app, hit play to select the game.
If you don't want the DLC, uncheck it in the Steam app.

notes.title: Music File
notes.notes:
Put the music I composed, "ReAward.mp3" into the game owner's local folder.
(Please enjoy the music by yourself. It is not available for commercial use.)

Right-click the name of the game.
Click Manage, Browse Local Files.
